prompts.title: Mûsâ ve Firavun dönemi — saray
prompts.prompt:
Cinematic historical visualization of an ancient Egyptian royal court during the era
traditionally associated with the Quranic story of Moses and Pharaoh.

Ancient Egyptian palace environment, stone columns, painted walls, servants and officials
wearing historically plausible ancient Egyptian clothing, Nile Valley atmosphere.

The scene should resemble historically documented New Kingdom Egyptian architecture
without claiming that this is the exact palace of Pharaoh mentioned in the Quran.

Prophet Moses must not have an identifiable face.

Cinematic natural lighting, realistic materials, archaeological documentary realism.

AI-generated historical visualization, not a historical photograph.
prompts.negativePrompt: modern buildings, modern vehicles, modern clothing, fantasy elements, text, watermark, subtitles
